dark.note: default. Dark field, blue activations, red-orange for flagged H-neurons; the pair stays distinct for every common colour-vision type

clinical.note: high contrast, print-safe, no colour used decoratively

ember.note: dark field, warm ramp; flagged H-neurons in cyan, which stays distinct from amber for every common colour-vision type

cool.note: cool ramp; flagged H-neurons in orange against teal (colour-blind safe)

mono.note: only the hallucinating population carries colour

neuronscope-dark.label: NeuronScope Dark
neuronscope-dark.note: purple for interactive state, teal for data, emerald for success. Blood red and burnt umber are reserved for errors and warnings and appear nowhere else -- a colour that shows up decoratively stops carrying information.
